_comment: Allow-list of Biblica's openbible editions this app offers: "<iso>/<abbr>" (e.g. "ekk/OECV"). Which editions exist and where they are comes from bcv-commons/bibles' per-language text-route.json (src/lib/bw/text-route.ts) and each edition's _meta.json (src/lib/bw/published-text.ts); enabling an edition is a licensing decision made here. Other published sources (audiobiblia, eBible, CrossWire, Door43) need no entry.
